# Observa

Deterministic, bar-based backtesting engine with a canonical event history and
visual replay. Python API over a canonical Rust Engine.

## Start here
- Complete agent guide: llms-full.txt
- Getting started: docs/getting-started.md
- Strategy contract: docs/strategy-contract.md
- Execution model: docs/execution-model.md
- Data format: docs/data-format.md
- Examples: examples/ (quickstart.py, ema_yfinance.py, rsi_mean_reversion.py)
- Known limitations: docs/known-limitations.md
- GitHub/source: https://github.com/ErickNgumo/observa
